content.text:
Assessment B found no new detector findings on the six reader and composer `.vue` files, and one in-browser finding that pre-dates the change set. The repo is untouched (`git status` is clean), the live-server is stopped (port 8400), my tab is closed and the scratch copies are deleted. ## (a) Detector JSON summary The baseline was `git show 58c1082:` copied into a scratch tree with DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md, then rerun. **Six `.vue` files (ReaderView, ReplyComposer, ComposeCard, DraftEditorCore, MessageAttachments, AttachmentChooser)** - Default scan: `[]` (0 findings), same as baseline. - `--scope layout`: `[]`, same as baseline. - `--scope type`: `[]`, same as baseline. **`src/App.vue`**: 0 findings. **`src/assets/style.css`**: 6 findings now, 10 at baseline, all pre-existing. None is on a reader or composer selector, so none is a false positive about this change set. | Rule | Current line | Baseline line | Snippet | Status | |---|---|---|---|---| | side-tab (warning) | 895 | 884 | `.search-suggestion.highlighted`, inset box-shadow 4px stripe | pre-existing | | side-tab (warning) | 991 | 980 | `.inbox-row.focused`, 4px stripe | pre-existing | | side-tab (warning) | 2288 | 2225 | `.command-overlay li.highlighted`, 3px stripe | pre-existing | | design-system-radius (advisory) | 361 | 350 | `.split-tab`, `border-radius: 2px` | pre-existing | | design-system-radius (advisory) | 854 | 843 | `.contact-recent button`, `border-radius: 2px` | pre-existing | | design-system-radius (advisory) | 1025 | 1014 | `.row-select`, `border-radius: 3px` | pre-existing | - **False positives:** the three side-tab hits are the documented focus-bar signal, which DESIGN.md calls Dusk Lavender's "4px bar on the focused row". They are likely false positives, though that is a design judgement. The radius hits are real deviations from the DESIGN.md rounded scale, but they are outside the target. - **Resolved by the change set:** the baseline had three `design-system-color` advisories for `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35)` (lines 684, 910, 1274). They are gone now. ## (b) Overlay and console findings Page mutation worked (`document.title` and an appended script both took effect). I started the live-server on port 8400 and injected `http://localhost:8400/detect.js`. The console was readable through both my own `console` hook and `preview_snapshot.consoleEntries`. | State | Detector console output | |---|---| | Reader open (thread "Fixture thread 1"), last message expanded, Details open | `[impeccable] No anti-patterns found` | | Reply composer (`r`), then rescanned with Cc/Subject and caveat opened | `No anti-patterns found` (rescans via `impeccableScanAsync`) | | New-message card (`c` from the list) | `flat-type-hierarchy`: "Role sizes: body 12px, h2 12px, h3 12px (largest adjacent step 1.00:1; target 1.25:1; weight separates headings from body text)", on `` | - **The `flat-type-hierarchy` finding reproduces on a second open of the card.** The list view alone is clean. - **The `h2` is the composer's "New Message"** (12px, weight 600). The `h3` is "Recent cached mail" in the contact pane (12px, weight 600), which is outside the target. - **It is pre-existing.** The `.composer-heading h2` rule is identical at 58c1082 (12px, `--weight-strong`). - **It is arguably a false positive.** DESIGN.md says weight, not size, separates levels in this shell. - **It does not appear in the reader or reply states** because the reader's `h2` subject is 16px. ## (c) Measurements All figures are from `preview_evaluate` at 1280x800 unless stated. The app used the in-memory fixture, so each message has one To recipient. **Interactive elements under 24px (width or height)** | State | Element | Size | |---|---|---| | Reader, Details open | `summary` "Details" | 51.4 x 16.2 | | Reader, Details open | `span.participant` (Ada Fixture, From) | 204.4 x 16.2 | | Reader, Details open | `span.participant` (You, To) | 168.2 x 16.2 | | Reply composer | `button.field-summary` (To row) | 713.3 x 22.2 | | New message | none | all at least 24px | - **Smallest target that passes:** `message-toggle` 24px high, `message-reply` 24x24, `composer-caveat-toggle` 24x24, `field-toggle` 24.2px high, `composer-primary` and `composer-discard` 24.2px high, inputs 24.2px high. - **Reply, Cc/Subject open:** `field-input` is 24.2px high and `textarea` is 120px high. - **Reader and reply:** the first two `message-toggle` buttons have `tabindex=-1` (roving tabindex). **Text contrast (colour on effective background)** | Selector | Colour on background | Size / weight | Ratio | |---|---|---|---| | `.message-from` (collapsed) | 192,188,182 on 41,40,38 | 12px / 400 | 7.79 | | `.message-from` (active) | 255,255,255 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 600 | 12.97 | | `.message-snippet` | 192,188,182 on 41,40,38 | 12px / 400 | 7.79 | | `.message-body` (active message) | 255,255,255 on 51,49,46 | 15px / 400 | 12.97 | | `summary` (reader) | 192,188,182 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 6.86 | | `.field-label` | 192,188,182 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 6.86 | | `.draft-status` ("Saved in preview memory (non-durable) · not sent", amber) | 228,196,101 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 7.65 | | `.composer-kbd` | 192,188,182 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 6.86 | | `.composer-caveat` (opened) | 192,188,182 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 6.86 | | Reply quote `blockquote` | 192,188,182 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 6.86 | | `.composer-primary` | 255,255,255 on 71,70,68 | 12px / 600 | 9.43 | | `.composer-discard` | 192,188,182 on 51,49,46 | 12px / 400 | 6.86 | - **Not measurable:** `.message-trail`, `.reader-status`, `.attachment-meta` and `.composer-caveat` (while closed) were absent from the DOM in the fixture. The fixture has no quote, signature, attachments or read-state line. **Non-text contrast against the composer fill (51,49,46)** | Element | Border | Colour | Ratio | |---|---|---|---| | Subject `.field-input` | bottom 1px solid | 142,138,135 | 3.79 | | Subject `.field-input` | top, left | transparent (alpha 0) | 1.00 | | Cc/To `.field-input` unfocused | not measured | not measured | not measured | | `.field-textarea` | all four sides 1px solid | 142,138,135 | 3.79 | - The Cc and To inputs were focused when sampled (187,165,237, ratio 6.0), so their unfocused underline was not measured. It is presumably the same Graphite as Subject. **Focus ring after `.focus()` following a real keypress** | Element | `:focus-visible` | Outline | |---|---|---| | `.message-toggle`, first (inactive) | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.message-toggle`, active message | true | none (3px, grey default) | | `.message-reply` | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `details summary` | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.participant` (both) | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.composer-caveat-toggle` | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.field-summary` | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.field-toggle` | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.composer-primary` (Save and close) | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.composer-discard` | true | solid 2px rgb(187,165,237), offset 1px | | `.field-input` (Cc, Subject) | true | solid 1px rgb(187,165,237), offset -2px, border also turns violet | | `.field-textarea` | true | solid 1px rgb(187,165,237), offset -2px, border also turns violet | - **Active message toggle has no outline by design.** `style.css:1517` says "The active bar is the focus indicator for the message toggle: no second ring." The 3px inset bar is drawn whether or not the toggle is focused. - **Not present in the fixture:** the quote toggle, attachment action, and Retry and Save-now buttons (no matching element). **Tab stops** | Scope | Count | Elements | |---|---|---| | Reader, Details open, one To recipient | 5 | active `message-toggle`, `message-reply`, `summary`, 2 participants (From and To) | | Reader with 3 To recipients (synthetic: I cloned the recipient group twice) | 7 | same, with 4 participants | | Reply composer open | 11 | the 5 reader stops plus caveat toggle, `field-summary`, `field-toggle`, `textarea`, Save and close, Discard (11 includes the second To-row button) | | New-message card | 7 | caveat toggle, To input, `field-toggle` (Cc), Subject input, `textarea`, Save and close, Discard | - The 3-recipient count is an extrapolation. The fixture has no multi-recipient message. **Live regions** - **Reader alone:** none. - **Reply composer:** one, `` with text "Saved in preview memory (non-durable) · not sent". It is already populated on mount. - **New message:** the same single `role=status` span with the same text. - **Not present:** no `role=alert` or `aria-live` element was present in any state, and the visible `.draft-status` `

` has no role. **Horizontal overflow (`scrollWidth > clientWidth`, `clientWidth > 1`, visible elements)** - **Page-level:** `documentElement.scrollWidth` equals the viewport width in every state and size, so there is no page overflow. - **1280x800, reader and reply:** 1px on `.message-header` and `.message-toggle` (895 vs 894; 867 vs 866). `.composer-body` and `.composer-top` are 876 vs 873. `.composer-status-group` is 329 vs 326. - **1280x800, new message:** `.composer-body` and `.composer-top` are 863 vs 860, and `.composer-status-group` is 329 vs 326. - **1000x700, reply:** - same 1px, 3px and 3px items; - plus `.message-snippet` 406 vs 392 with `text-overflow: ellipsis`; - plus `h1.app-title` 187 vs 162 with ellipsis (outside the target). - **1000x700, new message:** - `.composer-body`, `.composer-top` and `.composer-status-group` as above (3px each); - plus an `overflow-x: auto` `div.` of 943 vs 918, which is outside the target. - **Root font 20px at 1000x700, reply:** - `.composer-status-group` is 406 vs 403; - `.message-snippet` is 508 vs 336, with ellipsis; - `h1.app-title` is 234 vs 132, with ellipsis; - four `button.` elements are 232 vs 223, with ellipsis (contact-pane buttons). - **Root font 20px at 1000x700, new message:** the same composer 3px overflows plus the four ellipsis buttons. - **20px reply, vertical:** `.reply-composer` is `overflow-y: auto` (clientHeight 303, scrollHeight 512). Save and close sits at y 823.6 to 851.9 against a 700px viewport. `scrollIntoView` brings it to y 622.6, so it is reachable by scrolling. ## (d) Skipped or failed steps - **Multi-recipient message:** the fixture has no thread with more than one To recipient, Cc, quote or signature, and no attachments or `.reader-status` line. Rows 0 to 17 all opened the same conversation (clicking a row did not change the open thread). The tab-stop count with 3 recipients is therefore synthetic. - **Retry and Save buttons:** none were rendered in the fixture, so there are no focus-ring measurements for them. - **Escape:** it did not close the reader in this environment. I closed it with the header "Close (Esc)" button instead.
